blocks.text:
Our willow fence have good quality:
 The willow fence are made of 100% real willow branch, nature willow color, so there are some wood smell when the first time you open the package, please do not worry, its safe and nice. The connecting points between the willow pieces are connected by high quality rivets , sturdy and durable
 Our willow fence can meet your various needs :
 The willow fence are multi-purpose for indoor, outdoor, garden, yard, apartment, balcony, patio, porch, deck, greenhouse, flower bed and many other places.
 The willow fence can be widely used as fences, dividers, expandable door climbing plants support or trellis. Also can be used for decorating space, hanging other small things or strengthening some privacy for you.
 Product specification:
 Color: Wood color
 Material: Willow wood
 Features:expandable, easy to set up and take down,easily attach to most surfaces
 Fully Closed Size: 11"L×47"W
 Fully Expanded Size:120"L×22" W
 The most widely used size:92"L×36" W
 Package includes: 2×Willow Fence

items.label: HIGH QUALITY MATERIALS
items.value: The willow trellis plant support are made of 100% real willow wood, nature willow color, willow sticks is about 1/4” to 3/8” thick, nice and sturdy.

items.label: WIDELY USED
items.value: The expandable lattice can be widely used as fences, dividers, expandable door or trellis, ideal for indoor, outdoor, garden, yard, apartment, balcony, patio, porch, deck, greenhouse, flower bed and many other places. And also can be used as a perfect support for climbing plants no matter short or tall plants, like ivy, vine, rose, cucumbers, clematis, morning glory or peas, and also applies to bushes, such as blackberry bushes or berry bushes.

items.label: EASY TO USE
items.value: The willow lattice fence panel is easy to set up and take down, also easy to move and use. There are a few long zip ties in the package, you can binding the fence to anywhere you want by zip tie. Our willow wicker fence stretch length can be adjusted to meet various needs, when its length expands, its height shrinks. Fully expanded size is 120X22inch, fully closed size is 11X47 inch, normally we use it in 36X92 inch.

items.label: UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY
items.value: The willow fencing is a adjustable frame, you can use it for DIY creation. You can wrap some of the led string light on the fence to decorate your festival party wall. You can added some artificial vine or faux leaf on the fence and fixed it to your balcony railing for decoration space and privacy protection at the same time. And you can hanging other small things on it, all decide by you,unleash your creativity, creating a better living atmosphere.

items.label: STRONG CONNECTION
items.value: The connecting points between the willow pieces are connected by high quality rivets, Just the right flexibility and high-quality structure make the willow fence expanded or contracted conveniently and smooth.
